feature_contracts.scope: static interface binding; behavioral results are verified separately

requirements.requirement: Provide the firmware-visible MMIO/CSR control and status interface.
Decode control registers into semantic configuration signals.
Transport model requests and responses with the mandated directionality.
Track request age, response freshness, and timeout conditions.
Gate actuator commands with safety, validity, and range checks.
Latch faults for firmware handling without synthesizing a substitute command.
Expose operating mode and safety inhibit status to software and system integration logic.
Actuator output validity must be deasserted whenever veh_state_valid is low, model response is invalid, model response is stale, timeout occurs, or safety limits are violated.
The commanded actuator data must remain bounded to firmware-programmed limits; if the bound check fails, validity is inhibited and the fault is latched.
The design must not replace an invalid or missing command with a fallback command; instead, it must inhibit output validity.
Model requests are emitted only when the request path is enabled and the controller is not in fault inhibit mode.
Model response readiness is asserted only when the response can be safely accepted and processed.
All firmware-visible registers must be reachable through real MMIO decode.
Bulk history/FIFO storage is implemented through the declared memory macro and must not be flattened into registers.
Stale-data detection uses stored request/response age history and latches a fault when age exceeds the configured timeout.
The transparent reference path shall preserve traceability of speed input, request generation, and response consumption for software analysis.

Generate semantic control registers for the controller.
Expose latched fault, safety inhibit, and operating mode readback.
Provide ready/valid semantics for firmware transactions.
Keep register semantics transparent and directly readable.
Each declared register must be reachable through decode.
Write accesses update only the targeted semantic control field.
Read accesses return the current semantic control or status value.
The block must not expose inaccessible internal state as software-visible.
Control outputs are real module outputs and must be consumed by downstream control logic.

All writable control outputs reset to safe disabled values. Readback outputs are valid only after reset deassertion and transaction processing. The register block clears transient transaction state but does not clear external fault state ex
Create model requests from the transparent reference input path.
Respect the configured active speed range of 20–55 m/s or firmware overrides.
Handshake with the model transport path using valid/ready semantics.
Expose request token and request age for timeout tracking.
A request may be emitted only when enabled and vehicle-state-valid is asserted.
Request payloads must encode the current vehicle speed and reference context needed by the surrogate path.
If the model request is not accepted, valid remains asserted only according to the defined handshake state machine.
No fallback request or substitute command is allowed.
Requests are deasserted on reset. Request token and age counters return to a known reset baseline. No substitute or fallback request is emitted on reset.
Receive model-request ready as an input.
Emit model-response ready as an output.
Provide a traceable response-word tap for internal checking.
The bridge must preserve the mandated request/response direction contract.
Response-ready may only assert when the system is prepared to accept a response.
Response data is captured transparently for downstream use.
No synthetic response or command substitution is permitted.
Response ready and trace indicators are reset to inactive safe values. No response is synthesized on reset. The bridge never substitutes a response and never creates a fallback command.
Detect invalid, stale, and timeout conditions.
Latch fault state for software handling.
Assert safety inhibit whenever a violation occurs.
Report operating mode for integration and readback.
Faults latch on timeout, stale data, invalid vehicle state, or actuator bound violation.
Safety inhibit must be asserted whenever fault_latched is asserted.
No fallback or substitute actuator behavior is permitted.
Faults clear on reset, safety inhibit asserts to safe state, and operating mode indicates inhibited safe state. No command fallback is emitted on reset.
Convert validated surrogate output into actuator command data.
Clamp outputs to the configured actuator range.
Deassert command validity when disabled or faulted.
Never synthesize a substitute or fallback command.
Valid command output requires enable, no fault, no safety inhibit, and a valid observed response.
Command data must remain within configured min/max bounds.
If bounds or gating conditions fail, output validity must be deasserted rather than replaced.
The command path must remain bounded and deterministic.
On reset, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted and actuator_cmd_data is cleared to a benign internal value. No fallback command is generated.
Present technology-neutral block RAM style interface.
Preserve traceability for firmware and validation.
Implement bulk storage as an inferred memory rather than a flattened bank of scalar registers.
Return stored read data through the declared functional output port.
Bulk history storage shall remain in memory form and must not be flattened into registers.
The wrapper exists to support stale-data and timeout evaluation.
Response age output is derived from stored history and current observation state.
Block RAM read data is consumed by the wrapper as part of history reconstruction and stale-data tracking.
Infer one synthesizable unpacked memory array with synchronous access so FPGA tools can map it to block RAM.

Map technology-neutral memory behavior to native block RAM.
Drive memory read data from the storage array to the history buffer.
Preserve the exact width and naming of the declared memory interface.
Avoid introducing any substitute memory model or fallback behavior.
Implement bulk storage as an inferred memory rather than a flattened bank of scalar registers.
Return stored read data through the declared functional output port.
The wrapper must drive bram_dout as the observable read data for the history buffer.
This module is the real producer of the memory read data consumed by adaptive_aero_history_buffer.
The memory interface shall remain technology-neutral and suitable for FPGA block RAM mapping.

notes: This is a conformance analysis, not a formal proof.
Missing or partial items should be reviewed and turned into executable assertions/tests where needed.
Behavioral obligations are nonblocking here only when routed to executable RTL verification checkers.
Inconclusive is preserved when the checker lacks enough evidence; no fake pass is reported.
